newsitem.title: CHINA: China ICBC loans hit 1.8 trillion yuan at end-May.
newsitem.headline: China ICBC loans hit 1.8 trillion yuan at end-May.

text.p: Outstanding loans made by the state-owned Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) totalled 1.833 trillion yuan ($220 billion) at the end of May, the Financial News said on Friday.
Total loans had risen by 37 billion yuan since early in 1997, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
Deposits totalled 2.055 trillion yuan at the end of May, after increasing by 140 billion yuan in the first five months of the year, the newspaper said.
The ICBC was the first state-owned commercial bank to have total deposits of more than 2.0 trillion yuan, it said.
